The Hurricane of the Varstray - v4.00 Major Updatet and Price revision
notes.notes:
[h1]■This implementation is being content[/h1]
[list]
[*][b] Price revision[/b]
[*][b] v4.00 Major Updatet[/b]
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11165053/32433cfff6b240e2f51547db72c82c3f4d9568ba.jpg[/img]

[h1]■For the revision of the price[/h1]
The price revision was implemented.(Price Cut)

Examples of price
[h1][b]$15.99　→　$9.99[/b][/h1]



[h1]■v4.00 Patch Details[/h1]
○Adjustments
[list]
[*]Play Character, the sub- weapon, all the stages, boss attack, were seeded to adjust other various game balance.
[/list]

○New implementation content
[list]
[*]Added "Practice mode" to "Challenge mode" .
 *Play in the stage unit became possible.
  Update score will be reflected in the online leader board (ranking).
[*]Ground objects : has implemented a hidden bonus target (Fermion target ) 
The One stage has six hidden.
Winning score will continue to rise to every one to continue to defeat.
[*]Air products : It added a combined type medium-sized enemy.
It will be a bonus when you destroy the core before coalescence.
[*]It is now possible to acquire a disabling bonus when you destroy all of the battery of each attack phase of each side boss.
[*]"The number of times using the Baryon Laser bonus" has been implemented to clear the stage result.
[*]BGM has been added to the final stage of the last boss.
[/list]


○Changes
[list]
[*]Play operation "SHOT + SPEED DOWN" the was made to "SPEED DOWN" only.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11165053/ee5aa206664b700b0a9aeeb9cb010d15edcec81c.jpg[/img]
